Rio Tinto (2022). Rio Tinto partners with Government of Canada to decarbonise RTFT and boost critical minerals processing. News release, Business Wire, 11 October 2022.

BACKGROUND ONLY - no extraction. What it is and why no data: Corporate news release: funding, project list and facility-level emission claims; no per-tonne energy, cost or emissions for any process technology. What it does have: RTFT (Sorel-Tracy, Quebec) 2021 emissions implied at about 0.96 Mt CO2e (BlueSmelting cut of about 670 kt CO2e is up to 70% of it); BlueSmelting ilmenite smelting claimed to emit 95% less GHG than the current reduction process; demonstration plant of up to 40,000 t ilmenite per year (completion expected H1 2023); C$737M programme with C$222M from the Strategic Innovation Fund. Useful to calibrate the Quebec titanium-slag node, not as an archetype.
